luciole.title: Luciole
luciole.description: Conversational AI agent that automates tech intelligence: collects, analyzes and summarizes 200+ articles/day from 40+ RSS sources.
luciole.deliverables: ReAct agent with 6 tools, automated RSS ingestion pipeline, web interface with SSE streaming, custom RAG system, anti-injection security, Docker deployment
luciole.context: Built by a team of 4 during a 70-hour AI training program. IT teams spend about 15 min per article on manual monitoring — this agent reduces that to seconds per query.

deliverables.title: ReAct conversational agent
deliverables.description: Reason → Act → Observe loop with intelligent routing to 6 tools (web search, RAG, SQL, vision, preview digest, send digest). Model cascade Gemini flash / flash-lite / pro based on detected complexity.

deliverables.title: Automated monitoring pipeline
deliverables.description: Daily collection of 38 RSS feeds, topic filtering, content scraping, parallelized LLM enrichment (5 threads), RAG indexing with chunking and embeddings. Runnable as one-shot or via APScheduler.

deliverables.title: Luciole web interface
deliverables.description: Jinja2 frontend with custom design system, SSE response streaming, JWT authentication with user accounts, persistent conversation history in PostgreSQL (Neon), file upload (images, PDF) with magic bytes validation.

deliverables.title: Custom hybrid RAG
deliverables.description: Numpy semantic search (cosine similarity on gemini-embedding-001) + BM25 lexical + freshness score + user feedback. HyDE query expansion and optional Cohere re-ranking. No external RAG framework.

decisions.title: Custom numpy RAG over LangChain/ChromaDB
decisions.description: Cosine similarity computed directly with numpy on JSON-stored embeddings. Eliminates external vector store dependency, reduces infra complexity and gives full control over hybrid scoring (semantic + BM25 + freshness + feedback).

decisions.title: Model cascade over a single model
decisions.description: A fast classifier (gemini-2.5-flash-lite) routes each query to the right model: flash-lite for greetings/FAQ, flash for standard reasoning, pro for complex queries. Reduces API costs while maintaining quality.

decisions.title: SSE streaming over classic request/response
decisions.description: Responses are streamed via Server-Sent Events with typed events (thinking, tool_result, chunk, done). Users see the selected tool and the response appearing in real time instead of waiting several seconds.

poei-mainframe-gestion-clientele.title: Mainframe customer manager
poei-mainframe-gestion-clientele.description: Banking customer management system built on mainframe z/OS in three stages: batch COBOL/JCL processing, DB2/SQL relational queries, and a real-time CICS transactional application.
poei-mainframe-gestion-clientele.deliverables: Batch and transactional COBOL programs, SQL scripts, BMS screens, compilation and execution JCL, VSAM files, full project report
poei-mainframe-gestion-clientele.context: Simulate the full cycle of a mainframe application around a single business domain — from batch processing to real-time transactional screens.

deliverables.title: 14 batch COBOL programs with 43 JCL
deliverables.description: Complete sequential processing: VSAM KSDS creation, SORT/MERGE, CALL subprograms, account statement editing with control breaks and totals.

deliverables.title: DB2 system with embedded SQL
deliverables.description: 11 COBOL-SQL programs on a 5-table schema (CLIENT, REGION, PROFESSI, NATCOMPT, MOUVEMENT). Parameterized cursors, COMMIT/ROLLBACK transaction management, views and indexes.

deliverables.title: Interactive CICS application — 7 transactions
deliverables.description: Full customer management CRUD in pseudo-conversational mode: generic pagination, real-time VSAM navigation via alternate indexes (AIX/PATH), regional statistics. 7 BMS maps with FSET/DATAONLY/dynamic CURSOR optimizations.

deliverables.title: Docker container with web API and CI/CD
deliverables.description: Docker image compiling the 15 batch programs, simulating DB2 via SQLite and replaying CICS screens. GitHub Actions pipeline compiling and running smoke tests on every push.

decisions.title: GnuCOBOL + Docker rather than z/OS alone
decisions.description: Programs were written for z/OS but adapted for GnuCOBOL (ASSIGN TO file instead of DD names, LINE SEQUENTIAL) to enable local compilation, CI and web demo without a mainframe.

decisions.title: SQLite to simulate DB2 off z/OS
decisions.description: DB2 programs use EXEC SQL which GnuCOBOL cannot compile. A Python module (db2_sim.py) replicates the schema on SQLite to make queries executable in the Docker container.

decisions.title: Pseudo-conversational CICS with COMMAREA
decisions.description: Standard z/OS pseudo-conversational pattern for the 7 CICS transactions: each SEND MAP interaction frees the task, context is preserved via COMMAREA on RETURN TRANSID.

tour-de-controle.title: Tour de Contrôle
tour-de-controle.description: Full-stack restaurant cash register management application with real-time dashboard, role-based team management, filterable transaction journal and complete audit trail.
tour-de-controle.deliverables: Swagger-documented REST API, full React interface, JWT authentication with RBAC, automatic cash discrepancy detection, staff CRUD, PostgreSQL with Sqitch migrations, Docker Compose 5 services
tour-de-controle.context: Addressing a real restaurant need: centralizing cash register and staff management into a single, reliable, and secure tool.

deliverables.title: Cash register management (La Caisse)
deliverables.description: Opening and closing registers with physical fund entry and automatic discrepancy detection. Full session history per cashier.

deliverables.title: Transaction tracking (Le Flux)
deliverables.description: Recording transactions by payment type (card, cash, meal vouchers, etc.), with advanced filters and pagination.

deliverables.title: Staff management (L'Équipage)
deliverables.description: Full CRUD for team members with 4 role levels (Developer, Manager, Supervisor, Waiter) and password reset by email.

deliverables.title: Real-time Dashboard (La Vigie)
deliverables.description: Synthetic view of real-time KPIs with payment breakdown chart, and complete audit trail of all actions (who, what, when) stored in JSONB, filterable by date and user.

decisions.title: JWT via httpOnly cookies over localStorage
decisions.description: Authentication tokens are stored in httpOnly cookies to eliminate the risk of theft via XSS. The sameSite=none flag is enabled in production to handle cross-domain between Railway and Vercel.

decisions.title: Sqitch over an ORM for migrations
decisions.description: Database migrations are managed with Sqitch (pure SQL), ensuring full control over the schema and avoiding ORM abstractions for a business-query-focused project.

decisions.title: Monorepo with Docker Compose over a decoupled architecture from the start
decisions.description: Frontend, backend and database are orchestrated via Docker Compose to simplify local startup and environment consistency, while remaining separately deployable (Vercel + Railway + Neon).

oklm-drag-club.title: OKLM Drag Club
oklm-drag-club.description: Static showcase website for a drag podcast that automatically aggregates episodes from the RSS feed and generates multi-platform listening links at build time.
oklm-drag-club.deliverables: Static Next.js site, RSS + Apple/Deezer API aggregation at build, dynamic SEO with JSON-LD and generated OG images, secured rebuild endpoint
oklm-drag-club.context: Give an independent podcast a web showcase by automating episode publishing without a database or CMS.

deliverables.title: Static showcase site with RSS data
deliverables.description: Fully static Next.js site that aggregates episodes from the Anchor.fm RSS feed at build time, with manual data merge (overrides.json) for missing links.

deliverables.title: Automatic multi-platform aggregation
deliverables.description: Parallel fetch of Apple Podcasts (iTunes Lookup) and Deezer APIs at build time to automatically generate listening links per episode, with graceful fallback if an API fails.

deliverables.title: Dynamic SEO and Open Graph
deliverables.description: Dynamically generated sitemap, structured JSON-LD per page (PodcastSeries and PodcastEpisode), and server-side generated Open Graph images for the home page, each show and each episode.

deliverables.title: Secured rebuild endpoint
deliverables.description: POST /api/rebuild route protected by timing-safe comparison that triggers a Vercel deploy hook, allowing site republishing without a git push when a new episode drops.

deliverables.title: Accessibility and security hardening
deliverables.description: Skip links, ARIA labels on all interactive components, keyboard focus management on the mobile menu, prefers-reduced-motion support. HTML sanitization of RSS descriptions (anti-XSS), CSP headers and restrictive permissions policy, safeJsonLd() function that escapes </script> tags.

decisions.title: RSS → third-party APIs → local overrides pipeline rather than a CMS
decisions.description: The Anchor.fm RSS feed is the source of truth, enriched by automatic merging with the Apple Podcasts and Deezer APIs. A local overrides.json file fills in the gaps (missing links, show classification). Three sources merged into a single data model, with automatic show and season detection via regex. No database to maintain, fast builds, zero cost.

decisions.title: Automatic show detection by title rather than manual tagging
decisions.description: The detectShow() function classifies each episode into its series (Drag Race France, Dragula, Les Traitres...) via pattern matching on the RSS title, with override support in overrides.json.

decisions.title: External links only, no embedded audio player
decisions.description: Deliberate choice to redirect to Spotify/Apple/Deezer/Amazon rather than embedding a player. Simplifies the site, respects the podcaster's analytics, and avoids rights issues.

stella-ecommerce.title: Stella
stella-ecommerce.description: Full stack e-commerce application for browsing, filtering, and purchasing stars, with secure authentication, cart and review system.
stella-ecommerce.deliverables: Interactive catalog, JWT/CSRF authentication, cart and wishlist, order system, Swagger-documented RESTful API, admin panel, payment module
stella-ecommerce.context: Personal project built to demonstrate full stack skills in real-world conditions: MVC architecture, multi-layered security, ORM and automated testing.

deliverables.title: Star catalog with search and filters
deliverables.description: Browse a star catalog with text search, advanced filters and detail pages. Data is paginated server-side and cached via node-cache.

deliverables.title: Secure JWT + CSRF authentication
deliverables.description: Sign up, login and logout with JWT tokens stored in httpOnly cookies. Every mutating request is protected by a CSRF token synchronized via Axios interceptor.

deliverables.title: Complete purchase flow
deliverables.description: Cart with quantity controls, persistent wishlist, checkout form with payment simulation and order history with status tracking.

deliverables.title: Admin dashboard
deliverables.description: Admin-only interface exposing system statistics (users, orders, revenue) and user management via dedicated endpoints.

decisions.title: Zustand over Redux
decisions.description: Redux Toolkit is oversized for 5 stores: slices/thunks boilerplate adds no value. Zustand weighs ~1 KB gzipped, requires no Provider, and offers granular re-renders natively.

decisions.title: Custom DI container over Awilix or InversifyJS
decisions.description: The custom container (~220 lines, zero dependencies) covers exactly what the project needs: register, resolve, singleton. InversifyJS requires TypeScript decorators, incompatible with a pure JavaScript backend.

decisions.title: Repository pattern on the frontend
decisions.description: HTTP calls (Axios) are wrapped in typed repositories, decoupled from Zustand stores and components. This mirrors the backend architecture and allows mocking API calls in tests without touching Axios.
